headline: Duma AI understands what your operation is telling you.
lead: Duma AI connects information across Sidón modules to explain what is happening, identify patterns, prioritize what matters, and recommend better decisions.
principle: Sidón connects the operation. Duma AI understands it.
connectedTitle: Each module knows its part. Duma AI understands the operation.
connectedLead: Duma AI coordinates specialized agents that understand the context, rules, and information of each active module. Together, they create a connected understanding of the operation and present one clear response.
architecture: Each agent is configured around its module and the project’s operational reality. Duma AI selects relevant information, connects findings, and removes the need to interpret each source separately.
experienceTitle: Intelligence appears where it is most useful.
experienceLead: Duma AI brings the operation into an experience designed to clarify priorities, answer questions, and keep important results visible.

expressions.title: Analysis and insights
expressions.copy: Identifies patterns, explains changes, and directs attention toward conditions that require a decision.

expressions.title: ICOS
expressions.copy: Summarizes performance through clear, comparable indicators grounded in the project’s operational reality.

expressions.title: Chat and voice
expressions.copy: Lets people ask about the operation in natural language and receive answers grounded in project context.

expressions.title: Briefs
expressions.copy: Delivers information at the frequency each operation needs.

embeddedTitle: Duma AI also works inside the modules.
embeddedLead: Its intelligence appears inside workflows where it can improve understanding, reduce noise, detect a condition, or support a decision.
embedded: Smart Audits validates evidence quality and analyzes images.
Argos identifies configured conditions and preserves evidence.
NOD-IA shows where product gaps need attention.
Sense and Mantiz reduce noise and direct relevant conditions to maintenance.
autonomyLead: Duma AI begins by making conditions visible, explaining them, and recommending action. As the operation validates its results, configured actions can be enabled with greater autonomy.
control: People remain in control. Each advance depends on project context, information quality, and confidence built through consistent results.
ctaTitle: Let’s discuss what Duma AI can help your operation understand.
ctaLead: Tell us what information needs to be connected, which decisions need greater clarity, or which part of the operation remains difficult to interpret.
cta: Talk to us about Duma AI

chat.label: Conversation with Duma AI
chat.title: Ask what you need to understand about your operation.
chat.greeting: I am Duma AI. I can help connect signals, evidence, and priorities across your operation.
suggestions: Which evidence should I review first?
Help me prioritize the next maintenance action.
chat.reply: This demo shows how Duma AI connects available context to guide the next operational review.

prototype.readingTitle: A signal is clearer in context.
prototype.readingLead: Select a module to see how Duma organizes available information and guides an operational conversation.
prototype.capabilityTitle: Duma appears in the form each decision needs.
prototype.gamesTitle: Explore how Duma connects signals and evidence.
prototype.gamesLead: Complete the available challenges to see how Duma supports operational understanding.
prototype.relationshipTitle: Duma understands the operation while remaining part of Sidón.
prototype.relationshipLead: Each module retains its workflow and context. Duma connects those readings when a decision needs to see beyond a single source.

modules.name: Sense
modules.finding: Makes a condition that needs attention visible.
modules.explanation: Relates variables, alerts, and context to show what is changing.
modules.recommendation: Review the condition with responsible people and the available history.

modules.name: Mantiz
modules.explanation: Connects tasks, assets, and follow-up to distinguish a priority from an isolated activity.
modules.recommendation: Confirm the next maintenance action and evidence that needs to be retained.

modules.name: Smart Audits
modules.finding: Turns an audit into reviewable evidence.
modules.explanation: Relates criteria, photographs, and findings to keep execution clear.
modules.recommendation: Verify the evidence and decide which condition needs follow-up.

modules.name: Argos
modules.explanation: Preserves the context needed to interpret a detection.
modules.recommendation: Review the condition within its location, moment, and corresponding protocol.

capabilities.label: Findings

capabilities.copy: Duma brings together signals and context to make a condition worth reviewing visible.

capabilities.label: Context
capabilities.title: Explain why a condition matters.
capabilities.copy: It relates available information so the operation does not have to interpret each source separately.

capabilities.label: Ask
capabilities.title: Ask with the right context.
capabilities.copy: Questions draw on the information, rules, and permissions available in the project.

capabilities.label: Follow-up
capabilities.title: Keep what needs continuity visible.
capabilities.copy: Duma's reading can support operational and executive follow-up without replacing responsible people.
